title: RWANG Profile Manifest
description: Normative schema for a project view-profile declaration (SPEC-5DRIVEN-01 A2 §4, Appendix A.3). Every profile declares required, optional, AND not_applicable views — absence is never silently interpreted as completeness. There is no fixed standard number of views.

profile_id.description: e.g. 5-driven-domain, flat-prd-sdd, ieee-full, microservices, or a project-specific id

views.description: 'optional' means: if present, must be fully valid. 'not_applicable' views answer 'declared absent' to Typed Queries and are excluded from coverage denominators — reports MUST NOT render them as coverage.

filename_convention.description: Adapter filename mode (SPEC A4 SS2.1.1). id-prefixed: <ID>--<name>.md (identity hinted by filename). name-only: <name>.md with in-file identity (frontmatter id: / %% @id); binding via registry canonical_path, conflicts fail RWG-109. Default: id-prefixed.

trust_hierarchy.description: Ordered contradiction-resolution sources, strongest first. Profile-owned — Core only executes the declared order. Default: [code, sdd, prd].

visual_model_keywords.description: Check #11 complexity heuristics. Adapter/profile-owned — never hard-coded in Core.

verification_sources.description: Which verification evidence Check #12 accepts for a requirement

requiredness.description: Per-predicate minimum multiplicity layered over the Core contract's structural cardinality, e.g. visualized_by: '1..*' for complex features in 5-driven-domain

domain_mapping.description: microservices only: whether service boundaries map onto the Domain view or Domain is not_applicable

viewName.description: Open set — views are projection lenses, not a fixed list. Common: Domain, Requirement, Feature, Design, Diagram, Verification, Test, Architecture, Implementation, Operations, Release.
